description: A single digit pulse counter with a large display. Several of them chain together through their jacks to count in tens and hundreds, with the digit each one rolls over on set in its menu

params.text: Switches the counting on and off; pressing it also sends a pulse from the ACTIVE output
Resets the counter, in the manner chosen in the menu; pressing it also sends a pulse from the RESET output
Counts one step by hand, the step a pulse at PULSE IN counts

inputs.text: A pulse or a gate here switches the counting on and off
A pulse or a gate here resets the counter, in the manner chosen in the menu
Each pulse here counts the counter one step on, or one step back while the menu has it decrementing

outputs.text: Sends a pulse whenever the counting is switched on or off, for passing the switch on to another BIGNUMBER
Sends a pulse whenever the counter is reset, for passing the reset on to another BIGNUMBER
Sends a pulse when the counter passes the overflow digit set in the menu, for driving the next BIGNUMBER along a chain; a reset neither fires it nor leaves it armed

notes: the display reads NEXT PULSE RESET while a reset is held back to the next pulse, and RESET ARMED once a reset has arrived and has not yet been applied
menu: Reset to the next CLOCK IN — holds a reset back until the next pulse arrives at PULSE IN, which settles a reset and a pulse landing together
PULSE IN DECREMENT MODE — counts backwards on each pulse instead of forwards
COUNT BEATS — starts the count at 1 rather than 0, for counting beats, and moves 0 to the end of the count
Overflow on — sets the digit the counter rolls over on, 0 to 9
